case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client name, industry, clear objectives, quantified $320K savings, multiple category-level proof points all supplied – sufficient for a strong case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: Defense electronics manufacturer secures $320K in annual savings and standardizes procurement in just five months
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Arotech Corporation, a multi-site defense and simulation manufacturer, managed more than $35M in annual spend through fragmented, business-unit level buying. The decentralized approach left the company with hundreds of suppliers, inconsistent pricing, and virtually no enterprise contracts or spend visibility. With private-equity owners seeking margin expansion, leadership needed a rapid, data-driven procurement program that would capture cost savings without disrupting mission-critical supply lines.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A multi-site defense and simulation manufacturer managed more than $35M in annual spend through fragmented, business-unit level buying. The decentralized approach left the company with hundreds of suppliers, inconsistent pricing, and virtually no enterprise contracts or spend visibility. With a focus on operational efficiency and margin improvement, leadership needed a rapid, data-driven procurement program that would capture cost savings without disrupting mission-critical supply lines.
approach_summary: Mapped $35.6M in AP data across 12 categories, isolating $21.4M in addressable spend and cleansing supplier records to create the client’s first enterprise-wide spend baseline.
Ran competitive bid events for Audio-Visual/IT COGS, shifting volume to Connection, Tierney/Bluum and CDW to deliver a 6% price reduction on $2.5M of production inputs.
Renegotiated a high-value Rave Computer agreement, securing a 4% rate cut on $1.6M in annual hardware spend with no change to approved configurations.

Leveraged OMNIA Partners GPO programs to slash travel costs – 16% on car rentals with Enterprise/National and 16% average on preferred hotels – and to implement a dual-source MRO strategy with Grainger and Fastenal.
Stood up a center-led procurement model, loading new contracts and rates into Egencia and the ERP system, and establishing savings tracking dashboards for ongoing governance.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya unlocked $320,069 in verified annual run-rate savings across six categories, with the first $220K flowing through P&L within 60 days. Beyond the hard dollars, the engagement established the client’s inaugural enterprise spend baseline, centralized travel booking, and introduced a scalable supplier governance process—laying the groundwork for future sourcing waves and sustainable margin improvement.
where_we_were_unique: Captured first savings within 60 days by targeting quick-hit renegotiations and existing GPO contracts.
Combined defense-sector sourcing knowledge with deep GPO relationships to preserve supply continuity while cutting costs.
Hands-on data cleansing created the client’s first holistic spend view, enabling fact-based executive decisions.
Collaborative rollout—rates were pre-loaded into Egencia and ERP systems, minimizing disruption for end users.
